purpose: A message that stays in the page — neither interrupting like a dialog nor leaving like a toast. For conditions the user needs to keep seeing.

supplied: role=alert on the error and warning variants, so they are announced when they appear
the variant is carried in text and icon, not by colour alone
the dismiss control is a real button with an accessible name
required: a message that says what to do, not only what went wrong
do not use `onDismiss` for something the user must act on — a dismissible error can be dismissed unread

composition.notes: Actions belong in `actions`, which keeps them in the alert's landmark rather than loose in the body.

safeMutations.rationale: `variant` is the severity. Downgrading an error to info changes what the page is telling the user, and it changes whether it is announced at all.

propNotes.variant: Decides the role: error and warning are announced, info and success are not.
